g.text: 1. The LED is powered from the supply power (12V DC nominal, 48V max).

g.desc: 1. The LED is powered from the supply power (12V DC nominal, 48V max).

g.text: 2. The Green and Blue channels of the RGB LED are switched using a high-side PNP transistor.

g.desc: 2. The Green and Blue channels of the RGB LED are switched using a high-side PNP transistor.

g.text: - OFF: Supply power not connected or off.

g.desc: - OFF: Supply power not connected or off.

g.text: - GREEN: Supply power connected and routed to DUT.

g.desc: - GREEN: Supply power connected and routed to DUT.

g.text: - BLUE: Supply power connected but NOT routed to the DUT (e.g. fuse blown).

g.desc: - BLUE: Supply power connected but NOT routed to the DUT (e.g. fuse blown).

g.text: - RED: Supply power connected but polarity reversed, NOT routed to the DUT.

g.desc: - RED: Supply power connected but polarity reversed, NOT routed to the DUT.
